## install: settings.json (permissions.deny collapsed to a count)
{
  "hooks": {
    "Stop": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "<HOME>/.devflow/scripts/hooks/run-hook capture-turn",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "UserPromptSubmit": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "<HOME>/.devflow/scripts/hooks/run-hook capture-prompt",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "<HOME>/.devflow/scripts/hooks/run-hook capture-question",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ],
        "matcher": "AskUserQuestion"
      }
    ],
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "<HOME>/.devflow/scripts/hooks/run-hook session-start-context",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "tui": "fullscreen",
  "env": {
    "ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH": "true",
    "ENABLE_LSP_TOOL": "true",
    "ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H": "true",
    "CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS": "40"
  },
  "showTurnDuration": true,
  "showClearContextOnPlanAccept": true,
  "permissions": {
    "deny": "<170 entries>"
  }
}
